title: feat(auth): an invitation is accepted in one step with the proof its mail carries
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

Fixes #34257
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：邀请邮件里的链接带一个只在邮件里出现的凭证；受邀人打开链接后，一次提交（姓名+密码，或 Google / Microsoft 登录）就完成建号、邮箱验证、接受邀请和登录。复制的链接不带凭证，仍走今天的流程。
- 为什么改：受邀人今天要注册、收验证邮件、再登录、再点接受，四步才能进组织（cloud#4470 依赖这一步）。
- 风险与回滚：新增一个公开的认证入口和一个 spec 可选键 `SendTemplateInput.deliverOnly`，原有路由和复制链接的行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR，已发出的邮件链接退回今天的登录流程。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-mailbox-proof.ts`（凭证核验、先原子消费再建号、已有账号的回退）；`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-service.ts` 的 `sendTemplate`（只投递不入库）；`docs/adr/0138-…` 新增的一条修订。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/invitation-one-step-acceptance-34257.test.ts`，预期 16 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：批准 ADR-0138 本次修订对裁决 6413975861 Q2 B 的细化——带凭证的邮件链接即证明邮箱，复制的链接仍需验证邮件。

## What changes

- **The invitation mail carries a mailbox proof.** Each invitation mail's accept link carries a single-use proof bound to the invitation, its address and its expiry, handed to the mail as a deliver-only value; a resend retires it. The proof is never at rest in clear, the stored mail row never holds the proof, and the copy-link action answers the link without it. A send whose proof cannot be issued still goes out, as today's link.
- **`SendTemplateInput.deliverOnly`** (`packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`, a spec contract widening, owed review at the contract tier). Render values delivered with the message and never written to the stored mail row; a send carrying them is delivered inline, never through the durable queue. Only the server-side template send declares the key: `POST /email/send` and a script's `ctx.email.send` take a `SendEmailInput`, which has none. This is narrower than "SendEmailInput / SendTemplateInput" in the ruling: the key rides the server-side send only, and the caller-facing doors keep their shape.
- **One door redeems it**: `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/accept-invitation-with-proof` (route ledger row and mounted-surface entry added).
  - Rate limit first, per client address and per invitation (10 per 60 s, `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`).
  - Proof mode: the invitation must be pending and the proof must be the one issued for it, its address and its expiry. A bad proof gets one `INVALID_TOKEN` refusal that does not say which check failed, and the real proof stays usable.
  - An address with a verified account, a linked provider account, a second factor or a directory-managed source, or a server in SSO-only mode or with email and password off, answers `sign_in` and leaves the proof unspent.
  - The sign-up gates run before anything is written: password length, complexity, breach check, sign-up switched off, a name for a new account, and the audience admission.
  - The proof is spent before anything is written, and only once. Then the account is created, or an unverified account gets the typed password and loses every session; the address is verified, a session is issued, and the invitation is accepted.
  - Session mode (no proof, the provider return): accepts only when the session's address is the invited one and verified, otherwise answers `verify_email`.
- **ADR-0138 D2 note** (the single authorized note): the door's rules; the anonymous `GET /api/v1/auth/oauth2/client-name` read that #34265 adds (#34168), named in the same amendment at rule level; and the refinement of ruling 6413975861 Q2 B quoted in it.
- **`@object-ui/auth`**: `acceptInvitationWithProof(input)` on the client, the context and `useAuth`.
- **Accept page**: a signed-out visitor whose link carries the proof sees one form, a name and a password, or a provider sign-in, in place of the sign-in redirect. The accept page does not keep the proof in its address. On acceptance the page shows the joined state, and Continue enters the organization as it does today. A provider sign-in returns to the page, which redeems the invitation for the new session. A link without the proof keeps today's path. Eleven new `organization.accept.*` keys in every pack (zh-Hant generated).

## Tests

New tests, in card-named files; every test name states a rule:

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-one-step-acceptance-34257.test.ts`: 16 tests over a real `AuthManager` and a memory engine.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/send-template-deliver-only-34257.test.ts`: 3 tests.
- `ui/packages/auth/src/__tests__/acceptInvitationWithProof-34257.test.ts`: 4 tests.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/organizations/__tests__/acceptInvitationOneStep-34257.test.tsx`: 10 tests.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.test.ts`: two plugin-list pins now name the new plugin.

Head 9b95ba909 changes only the changeset text after these runs; the changeset gates pass on it.

<details><summary>Runs at fcc0f015d (after merging origin/main), under the shared verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: Test Files 280 passed (280), Tests 5662 passed, 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email test`: Test Files 54 passed (54), Tests 1023 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (with `check:test-typecheck`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email typecheck`: exit 0.
- ui: the two card tests, the accept page's three existing tests, the ADR-0060 product-neutral ratchet and all of `packages/i18n/src/__tests__`: Test Files 108 passed (108), Tests 1958 passed, 13 skipped. `@object-ui/auth` type-check exit 0. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 171 files passed, 2 skipped.
- Before the merge, at 4427a90a0: `@objectstack/spec`, `rest`, `organizations`, `client`, `service-sms`, `service-automation` and `plugin-dev` tests all exit 0; `@objectstack/spec` typecheck exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: every negative pin, mutated through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, red, then restored (blob equal to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

Each line: the rule broken, then what went red. Assertion text is not quoted.

- Deliver-only values written to the stored mail row: the deliver-only pin.
- A deliver-only send allowed onto the durable queue: the inline-delivery pin. Breaking only the send's own guard stayed green, because the one caller already asks for inline delivery; both had to be broken.
- The proof written into the mail's logged template data: the deliver-only-only pin. A first attempt changed nothing on disk that the send used and is not counted.
- The proof stored in clear: the never-at-rest pin.
- A bad proof spending the real one: the mismatch pin (the real proof was then refused).
- A redeemed proof left redeemable: the single-use pin. Before the pin was strengthened this stayed green, because an accepted invitation is no longer pending.
- The proof check forced to pass: another invitation's proof was accepted, and its pin went red.
- The expiry binding removed: the expired invitation was not refused with the one proof refusal.
- A resend not retiring the earlier proof: the resend pin.
- The linked-provider fallback removed: the door set the password instead of answering sign in.
- Sessions kept on a password replacement: the session-revoke pin.
- Session mode accepting an unverified address: the verify-email pin.
- No rate limit: the rate-limit pin.
- The verified-account fallback removed: the door set the password instead of answering sign in.
- The page keeps the proof in its address: the address pin.
- A link without the proof no longer sent to sign-in: the redirect pin.
- The provider sign-in returning with the proof: the provider-return pin.
- A refused proof shown with the server's own text: the refusal-message pin.
- No verify-email state on the provider return: the verify-state pin.
- The client accepting an answer outside the outcome vocabulary: the vocabulary pin.
- The client dropping a refusal's code and status: the refusal pin.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The vendor `accept-invitation` route is unchanged; its narrowing is #34272.
- If the vendor acceptance fails after the session is issued, the error is answered and the proof is already spent; the person is signed in and can accept from the page.
- The copy-action pin is an equality pin: the proof is never at rest in clear, so no mutation short of planting new code makes the copy action carry it. It has no ablation leg.
- Merge-tree against #34265 (`fb0d4b052`) and against origin/main was clean before the first push; the two PRs both touch `auth-manager.ts` and `auth-manager-before-hook.ts`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at fcc0f015d: 125 commands. The local results, with `--ran` reconciliation, are in the report comment on #34257.
- Fixed on this branch after the first gate run: `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` (the door now answers registered codes), `check:engine-double-contract` (ledger written with `--write`), `check:objectql-double-limit` (the double applies `limit` by presence), `check:route-envelope` (the door answers in the envelope, and the module is declared in `PLUGIN_ROUTE_MODULES`; the script's `--self-test` passes).
- `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt` read a full build and answer PREREQUISITE NOT MET locally: NOT MEASURED here, CI runs them.
- Clause-② re-measured: the vendor routes, the copy action and a send whose proof cannot be minted behave as today, and the stored mail row is unchanged. No request served today is refused.
- `packages/spec/src/**` is touched: `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts`.

</details>
